title: •_Millennium Falcon_
caption: •_Millennium Falcon_ (V)
game_text: May add 2 pilots. Chewie deploys -3 aboard. If _Falcon_ is about to use hyperspeed, draw destiny; if destiny < 3, hyperspeed = 0 this turn. Immune to attrition < 4 if Han or Chewie piloting (< 9 if both).
lore: Modified YT-1300 freighter. Owned by Lando Calrissian until won by Han in a sabacc game. 26.7 meters long. “She may not look like much, but she’s got it where it counts.”

notes: Unique. 'Millennium Falcon' italic in the slip heading and caption (_…_); _Falcon_ italic in the game text. Banner STARFIGHTER: HEAVILY-MODIFIED LIGHT FREIGHTER (printed card: MODIFIED LIGHT FREIGHTER). Stats POWER 3 / MANEUVER 5 / HYPERSPEED 6; deploy 3 / forfeit 7. Scomp ring → true. Icon column: nav (red box, R2 dome) only. Slip text matches the stub. Lore corrected from the scan: curly double quotes “She … counts.” (wiki has straight single quotes) and she’s; otherwise matches. Wiki set 'Premiere Limited'. Base scan only 350 px; copyright 1995 read off the V20 remake (TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. …). Modern: V20-L-millenniumfalcon.gif (745 px) is the Virtual Set 20 remake of the Falcon (different game text, same art) — art only; VB1 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
